about: Part f: Heirloom's words for quests both shards give, where Live's are the shorter and the steps are the same (read from both shards' 2026-11-21 23:16-23:18 pre-swap backups). Quests skipped and why are listed.

live.offer: Merchant Yulia, outside to the north-east, has a bronze ring for you. Pick it up and show me.
live.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
live.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

heirloom.offer:
You've found the Academy of Arcane Science. Most who come here want to throw fire. I don't teach fire.
I teach the mind: how to bend it, how to fool it, and how to keep your own. Do you want to learn?
heirloom.accept: I wish to become an enchanter.
heirloom.started:
Then start small. An enchanter's first tool is a ring with a rune cut into it, to keep a little power close.
Merchant Yulia, at her tent outside the Academy to the north-east, has a bronze ring for you. The Academy pays for it.
Bring it back and show me.

live.journal: Speak with Merchant Yulia at her tent by the foot of the ramp, outside the Academy in Freeport.
live.says: A bronze ring for a new enchanter.

heirloom.journal: Get your bronze ring from Merchant Yulia at her tent outside the Academy. She charges nothing for it.
heirloom.says:
A bronze ring for one of Azlynn's? It's on my table. Take it, no charge.
The Academy settles with me later. It always does, eventually.

live.journal: Show the bronze ring to Azlynn in Freeport.
live.says: It suits you. Wear it, and remember who gave it. Come see me again at level 2: I will have more for you.

heirloom.journal: Show the bronze ring to Azlynn in the Academy of Arcane Science.
heirloom.says:
Bronze. Cheap, honest metal, and the rune is cut true. That's all a ring needs to be.
Wear it. Then go and learn the city; nobody can bend a place they don't know. Come back to me at level 2.
heirloom.reminder: Merchant Yulia, at her tent outside the Academy. The ring costs you nothing.

live.offer: Every petitioner of our faith wears the cap. Merchant Olkan, outside to the north-east, has one for you. Get it and show me.
live.accept: I have come to learn the ways of the shaman.
live.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
live.started: A shaman! We see few of your calling here, but you are welcome among us. Take the Dark Ones bracers, put it on, and show me.

heirloom.offer:
You stand in the Shining Shield. Freeport calls us the Spiteful Shield, when it thinks we can't hear. Both names are true.
I am Denouncer Alshea. We mend what this city breaks, and we remember who asked. Have you come to serve?

live.offer: Hatebone thieves stole the Elddar tome. Kill them in the hills south of town and get the seeds back.
live.declined: Then come back to me when you are ready.
live.started: Good. Come back to me when it is done.

heirloom.offer:
Greetings. I am Fethinar Silspin, guildmaster of the magicians of the College of High Magic.
I called for every student of your rank. Will you hear why?
heirloom.accept: Why did you call for us?
heirloom.started:
Hatebone orcs fell upon a small band of our people and slew them. The elves were carrying the last known Elddar tomes.
If the orcs keep them, the College loses teachings it can never write again.
Even one of these orcs is too strong for you alone. Band together with other elves to bring the thieves down.
The hatebone thieves keep to the hills south of Fayspires. Recover a tome and bring it to me.

live.journal: Take elddar seeds from the hatebone thieves or orc burglars in the hills south-east of Fayspires.

heirloom.journal: Take an Elddar tome from the hatebone thieves in the hills south-east of Fayspires.

live.journal: Bring elddar seeds to Fethinar Silspin in Fayspires.
live.says: Good. Come see me again at level 7: I will have more for you.

heirloom.journal: Bring the Elddar tome to Fethinar Silspin in Fayspires.
heirloom.says:
The College owes you much. What you have saved could never be written again.
Take this scroll of Motivate. It will spur your pet on in battle.
Come back to me at level 7.
heirloom.waiting: Professor Skysign tells me you fought the thieves. Did you recover a tome?
heirloom.reminder: The hatebone thieves keep to the hills south of Fayspires. Band together with other elves and bring back a tome.

live.offer: Say what you must, I haven't got all day.
live.accept: I wish to become an apprentice.
live.started:
Oooohhh, well we do require that a prospective apprentice complete a number of tasks before the enrollment.
Your first task is to acquire an iron ring from the merchant outside. Her name is Yulia. She won't charge you for the ring.
When you have the iron ring, return to me and I'll send you on your second task.

live.journal: Buy an iron ring from Merchant Yulia at her tent outside the Academy in Freeport.

heirloom.journal: Buy an iron ring from Merchant Yulia at her tent outside the Academy in Freeport.

live.journal: Show the iron ring to Malsis in Freeport.
live.says:
Wonderful. That is no ordinary ring. A small amount of power has been infused into the metal. We'll discuss more of that later.
Take some rest now. Return when you are ready and you shall have your next task.
live.waiting: I take it you have the ring I sent you for?

live.offer: Go upstairs and out by the ramp to Merchant Olkan. He has burglar's gloves for you. Then show me.
live.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
live.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

heirloom.offer:
You found the door, so you're not hopeless. This is the Shining Shield. The street calls it the Spiteful Shield. Down here, it's mine.
I am Necorik. They call me the Ghost. Ask the people who owed me why, if you can find any of them.
Anyone who steals in Freeport steals for me, or stops stealing. Will you work for me?
heirloom.started:
Good. The Shield takes its cut of everything you take in this city. Everything. And you never, ever take from the Shield.
Go upstairs and out by the ramp. Merchant Olkan has a pair of burglar's gloves for you. Free: the last free thing you'll get from me.
Put them on, and come back to show me.

live.journal: Speak with Merchant Olkan, just outside the hall to the north-east, by the ramp, in Freeport.

heirloom.journal: Get a pair of burglar's gloves from Merchant Olkan, upstairs and out by the ramp of the Shining Shield's hall.
heirloom.answer:
Necorik sent me for burglar's gloves.
Just looking.
heirloom.says:
Burglar's gloves. Here. They cost you nothing; the Shield pays for its own, and it remembers what it paid.
Thin at the fingertips, so you'll feel the pins of a lock through them. Don't wear them in front of the Militia.
heirloom.waiting: One of Necorik's? I can always tell. You look at my shelves the way a cat looks at a fish.

live.journal: Show the burglar's gloves to Necorik the Ghost in Freeport.
live.says: It suits you. Wear it, and remember who gave it. Come see me again at level 2: I will have more for you.

heirloom.journal: Show the burglar's gloves to Necorik the Ghost, downstairs in the Shining Shield's hall.
heirloom.says:
They fit. A burglar's hands should be the quietest thing about them.
Learn this city: its alleys, its roofs, its gates and who stands at them. Come back to me at level 2.
heirloom.reminder: Merchant Olkan. Upstairs, and out by the ramp. The gloves are free. Don't haggle; he enjoys it too much.

entries.name: Bertoxxulous and the Throne of Plague

live.offer: You are a friend of the puslings now. Give me the Queen's stinger and I will make a scepter of it. Show the scepter to the Throne of Bertoxxulous, past the Bloody Portal, and he will come.
live.started: Bring your strongest. He is one tough foe.

heirloom.offer: You are a friend of the puslings now. Give me the Queen's stinger and I will make a bonescepter of it. Use it at the Throne of Bertoxxulous, past the Bloody Portal, and he will come.
heirloom.started: Bring your strongest. He is one tough foe.

live.journal: Give Queen Qy'tha's stinger to Witchdoctor Muglchlur.
live.says: There. The scepter of plague. The throne will answer it.

heirloom.journal: Give Queen Qy'tha's stinger to Witchdoctor Muglchlur.
heirloom.says: There. The bonescepter. The throne will answer it.

live.journal: Take the Bloody Portal to the Twins' valley and show the scepter of plague to the Throne of Bertoxxulous.
live.says: The throne shudders, and the Plaguebringer turns to face you.

heirloom.journal: Take the Bloody Portal to the Twins' valley and use the bonescepter at the Throne of Bertoxxulous.
heirloom.says: The throne shudders, and the Plaguebringer turns to face you.
heirloom.reminder: The throne answers only the bonescepter.

heirloom.journal: Kill Bertoxxulous the Plaguebringer before he leaves, an hour after he rises.
